ops.title: Orca adapter handoff: PR #6 merged as 972ea06 (ccr-orca lane closed)
ops.body:
Replaces monorepo cc-notes note 322e857, which does not resolve in this clone. It recorded the Orca 1.4.215 CLI facts and the lane's mid-flight state. The CLI facts are restated below.

## Merged state

PR #6 merged at head 84921dd as squash 972ea06 on main, after core #10 (2500982) and images #13 (40be400).

- `cc-remote orca recipes|wait|verify|gone`: internal/cli/orca_commands.go (tests orca_commands_test.go, checkout_test.go).
- Package internal/frontends/orca:
  - recipe.go: Recipe, Source, Lifecycle.
  - config.go: SourceOf and PluginOf over config.Config.
  - generate.go: the orca.yaml merge and the plugin files.
  - client.go: the orca CLI behind Runner, plus CLI resolution.
  - wait.go: preflight, wait, and the ssh config reader.
  - verify.go, gone.go.
- Skill: skills/remote-workspaces/SKILL.md.

## Recipe eligibility

A profile pairs with provider P when profile.machine names P, or when the profile has no machine entries and P is the config's default provider. There is no provider-by-profile cross product (root #861).

- Default recipe: the config's provider and profile, named `(default)`.
- Recipe ids: `<provider>-<profile>-ssh`.
- Every recipe sets `checkoutMode: provisioned-root`. The plugin artifact keeps schemaVersion 1; schema 2 is core's create result.
- Generation rates every eligible recipe through `provider.Rate`, using core's openProvider and the profile's machine entry. A pairing core would refuse fails generation instead of being skipped.
- Namespace Rate requires an image and a size. Create relies on Rate and no longer repeats the image check.
- Tests:
  - TestOrcaRecipesFromProfiles holds root's mixed fixture (exactly sprites-lean-ssh and namespace-full-ssh) and the case of a Namespace machine with no image.
  - TestSourceOf covers SourceOf.

## Lifecycle commands

- `--config`: an explicit path is written as given, repo-relative because Orca runs recipes from the repo root. When the flag is absent, the resolved absolute cfg.Path is pinned (#845), because Orca's GUI environment differs from the generating shell's.
- `--binary`: defaults to `cc-remote`. It is written verbatim through providers.ShellQuote and never resolved, so the monorepo's `./tools/cc-remote/bin/cc-remote` survives.
- `wait` must receive the same `--binary` and `--config`, because it requires the orca.yaml entry to equal the generated one.
- A `./` binary makes the doctor's command-path warnings blocking. Otherwise only the "not a repo-relative path" warning on recipe.create/suspend/resume/destroy is tolerated.

## ssh Include preflight (wait.go)

`wait` requires an Include of core's `cfg.State().SSHInclude()` glob (`<state>/ssh/*.ssh`) in ~/.ssh/config, above every Host and Match block. Core writes one Host block per workspace at `state.Dir.SSH(name)`; the Orca target host is the workspace name. A missing file reports the line to add.

The reader mirrors OpenSSH readconf:

- `sshDirective` and `sshDelim` port strdelim for the keyword:
  - Split on whitespace, a double quote, or `=`.
  - A quoted fragment joins its prefix, and one `=` is skipped.
  - An empty leading token rereads.
  - Trailing whitespace and form feed are stripped, and NUL ends the line.
  - A `#`-led keyword is ignored.
- `sshArgs` ports argv_split with terminate_on_comment for the arguments:
  - An unquoted `#` at a token start ends them.
  - Single and double quotes group, including mid-token.
  - A backslash escapes a quote, a backslash, or (outside quotes) a space.
  - An unterminated quote yields no arguments.
- `~/` expands to Home.
- Tests in wait_test.go:
  - TestWaitPreflightFailures: an Include scoped under Host or after Match, a commented-out Include, Include `x # glob`, an unterminated quote, and a missing file.
  - TestWaitAcceptsIncludeForms.
  - TestWaitKeepsHashInsideAnIncludePath.
  - TestWaitRejectsIncludeAfterAnyHostSpelling.
- Root #942 and the sol finder produced the comment and keyword fixes.

## Skill rules

- Ledger carry-forward (root #932):
  - A continuing budget imports its prior cc-remote-format ledger with `cc-remote ledger import`.
  - `ledger init` is only for a new budget with no earlier spend.
  - Spend recorded in any other form means stop and ask the owner.
  - No conversion runbook and no reset instruction belong in the skill.
- The skill documents `--config`, `--binary`, and the Include line.
- Root owns the final docs pass and the `--binary` wrapper wording in the workspace guide.

## Orca 1.4.215 facts

- The CLI cannot create a recipe workspace (no recipe flag on worktree create, no host add). Creation goes through the New Workspace composer; `wait` only preflights and polls.
- `orca vm recipe doctor` reads only orca.yaml.
- CLI resolution, with no fallback: ORCA_CLI_COMMAND, then orca-dev when ORCA_DEV_REPO_ROOT is set, then orca-ide on Linux outside an Orca terminal (ORCA_TERMINAL_HANDLE unset), then orca.
- The end-to-end composer flow is unverified. No UI or VM run happened, and all tests use the fake orca runner.

## Known gap: ccx:raw retargets

On this plain-git lane, `ccx vcs stack restack` replays a branch only onto its PR's current base. Moving #6 onto ccr-core, and later onto main after #10's squash, needed raw `git rebase --onto` plus `gh pr edit --base`, marked ccx:raw. The ccx fix is ccx task #80 / cc-context #205 (restack --parent on the git lane).

## For a follow-up adapter lane

- Verify the composer flow end to end: one Orca workspace from a generated recipe, then wait, verify, owner-authorized delete, and gone. Fill the skill's timing table from that run log.
- If core changes the fragment path or the result's target host, update wait.go's Include check and its tests together.
- Orca's server transport (`orca serve`) is not implemented; core refuses `--connection server`.
- When Orca's recipe or plugin schemas move past 1.4.215 (schemaVersion literal 1, the checkoutMode enum), regenerate and recheck generate.go and the doctor policy in wait.go.
